cpf-frs.title: CPF-001: CPF Retirement Sum (made up)
cpf-frs.content: The Full Retirement Sum (FRS) for members turning 55 in 2026 is $205,800. Members may withdraw amounts above the FRS at age 55.

cpf-withdrawal.title: CPF-002: CPF Withdrawal at 55 (made up)
cpf-withdrawal.content: Members can apply online via CPF website using Singpass, or at any CPF Service Centre with NRIC. Online applications processed within 5 working days.

cpf-life.title: CPF-003: CPF LIFE Payouts (made up)
cpf-life.content: CPF LIFE provides monthly payouts from age 65 for life. Payout depends on Retirement Account balance at payout start.

medisave.title: CPF-004: Medisave Withdrawal (made up)
medisave.content: You may use Medisave for approved medical expenses for yourself, spouse, children, parents, grandparents, and siblings. Claim limit depends on treatment type.

hdb-bto.title: HDB-001: BTO Eligibility (made up)
hdb-bto.content: First-timer applicants have priority over second-timers. Income ceiling: $14,000/month for families, $7,000/month for singles. Minimum age: 21 (families), 35 (singles buying 2-room Flexi). Must be Singapore Citizen.

hdb-grants.title: HDB-002: Housing Grants (made up)
hdb-grants.content: Enhanced CPF Housing Grant (EHG): Up to $80,000 for first-timer families with income ≤$9,000/month. Proximity Housing Grant (PHG): Up to $30,000 for living near parents/children. Singles can receive EHG up to $40,000 if income ≤$4,500/month.

lta-coe.title: LTA-001: COE Bidding (made up)
lta-coe.content: COE categories: Cat A (cars ≤1600cc), Cat B (cars >1600cc), Cat C (goods vehicles), Cat D (motorcycles), Cat E (open). Bidding exercises: 1st and 3rd Monday of each month. COE valid for 10 years.

lta-licence.title: LTA-002: Driving Licence (made up)
lta-licence.content: Renewal: Apply online via LTA website, 1-3 working days processing. Conversion from foreign licence: Depends on country; some require test. Provisional Driving Licence (PDL) valid for 2 years during learning.

ica-passport.title: ICA-001: Passport Renewal (made up)
ica-passport.content: Apply online via ICA website or at ICA Building. Processing time: 4-6 weeks (standard), 1-2 weeks (express, additional fee). Adult passport valid for 10 years; child passport (under 16) valid for 5 years. Biometric photo required.

iras-tax.title: IRAS-001: Income Tax Filing (made up)
iras-tax.content: Filing deadline: 15 April (paper), 18 April (e-filing). Tax reliefs: CPF contributions, NSman relief, parent relief, spouse relief. No-Filing Service (NFS): Some taxpayers auto-included, no action needed. First $20,000 of chargeable income is tax-free.
